title: Tesla's New Car Has No Steering Wheel. Is It Even Legal? #shorts

scenes.text: This taxi has no steering wheel, no pedals and no mirrors. Is that even legal?
It's Tesla's Cybercab. Two seats, cameras only, and paying riders in Austin since September.
But America's car safety rules assume a human driver. One says the brakes must work with a foot control.
So one day after launch, regulators opened an audit of about a thousand Cybercabs: how did Tesla certify them?
Tesla answered by the October deadline. Then it asked that every single answer be kept secret.
To be fair, regulators haven't found it breaks any rule. Rival Zoox took the other road: an official exemption.
Normal business secrecy, or should the public see the answers? Follow EV Drive.
